title: Quran Study 54: Sura 2, the Original Covenant, Adam, Satan, and the Angels (1982-10-22)
date_note: Explicit in the filename. This recording continues Study 53.
source_file: data/sources/playlists/audio-transcripts/54 - Quran Study 22 Oct 1982 By Dr Rashad Khalifa.csv
document_summary: The continuation of the October 22, 1982 study. It begins by completing the strayers and hypocrites discussion, then moves through Quran 2:20–39. Major subjects include conditional worship, A.L.M. and numerical structure, the challenge to produce a Sura, allegory, God misleading only those who first choose wickedness, two deaths and two lives, the original covenant of Quran 7:172, creation of the heavens and Earth, Adam as representative, the angels' knowledge of future corruption, Adam being taught the names, the exposure of Satan, prostration, Paradise, the tree, repentance, guidance, the nature of angels, the soul dimension, and Dean Mahmoud's alternative suggestion that the names may refer to divine qualities.

sections.summary: Quran 2:21–26 commands worship of the Creator, challenges doubters to produce a comparable Sura, warns of Hell, promises gardens, and explains that God uses even a mosquito as an allegory. Rashad interprets the challenge as mathematical as well as literary and says God misleads only those who first choose wickedness.

Why did God use a mosquito as an allegory?
